name: Context Isolation Enforcement
description: Enforce contextIsolation: true in all BrowserWindows. Preload scripts must only expose sanctioned APIs via contextBridge. No direct window property injection. Verify preload scripts are audited and versioned.
purpose: Ensure renderer JavaScript cannot access Electron internals or preload script scope by enforcing context isolation and using contextBridge exclusively for all renderer-accessible APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: contextIsolation: true on every BrowserWindow configuration
All renderer-accessible APIs are exposed through contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld()
No preload script uses window.X = ... pattern for API exposure
Preload script inventory exists with version tracking
Each exposed API has a documented purpose and security review
